inputs.modified_text: I got this from Bloomberg claiming every day as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop. Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through. This is classic elite manipulation at work. The institutions are coordinating the whole mess to spike energy prices for their own profit while using these reports to push a fake global demand for an end that actually serves their hidden interests in resource control and power consolidation. The contrast with Israel is just another layer of narrative inversion to keep populations divided and distracted from who is really pulling the strings.
